_comment: Expectation manifest for prompt-improve's frozen acceptance-checks.
expect "green" = must exit 0. A check file missing from this manifest FAILS the gate.
LOCKED (evals/**): improvement loops may never edit this file.

mutations.why: judge without a key falls through to Jev and fails with exit 1, so the skill reads it as a broken judge and stops grading instead of switching to Haiku
a Haiku grade labelled jev reads as Jev's measurement, so the user trusts a different judge's calibration as if it were Jev's
without the exit-3 rule the skill cannot tell 'Jev not set up' from 'Jev failed', and never reaches the fallback
mutations.find: Exit 3 means Jev is not set up
mutations.replace: A non-zero exit means Jev failed

mutations.why: dropping the Haiku dispatch leaves a missing key with no judge at all
without the announcement, Haiku's whole-level scores are read against Jev's continuous ones
mutations.find: Say once that grades come from Haiku, not Jev;

mutations.why: without the ban, a failed judge invites a guessed score dressed as a grade
without the guard no brief closes on the keep-going line, so a long run ends turns announcing its next step instead of taking it
filed under an earlier part, the line lands mid-brief and the report text closes the prompt instead
without the plan-only exclusion a plan brief tells the run to keep going past the plan into building
